digest.component_or_area: Plan review: AC satisfiability criterion and container sibling roster
propositions: Plan review certified plans with mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria across parent and children without catching contradictions until mid-implementation or close gate, requiring full re-review when descriptions are amended.
No existing plan-review criterion owns the joint satisfiability concern: whether a ticket's own acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations can all hold simultaneously.
G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because the sibling roster it receives carries only child ids and titles, insufficient to discharge the coverage test against each parent acceptance criterion.

The sibling roster is built by three independent duplicate expressions in pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, and eval_solver.py, causing divergence between production and eval harnesses on what data the roster contains.

Roster must move from per-pairing instructions to the system prompt prefix to avoid re-sending the acceptance-criteria corpus once per child pairing, and its token cost must be included in the parent_tokens prefix estimate.
